assumptions: No clinical model or history definition approved.

Effect present/absent/not_assessed is an explicit applicability input; an absent case is not_applicable with no posterior claim, never a negative finding or a fake negative review posterior; unresolved or not_assessed pauses for clarification.
All 20 BN-13 distributions were missing and are synthetic uniform references here; complete clinical table provenance remains a release blocker.

Full BARS item responses are measurement context only when the complete reviewed source is available; no diagnosis is inferred from an unreviewed BARS total and the global 2 or greater threshold is a review candidate only, never an activation claim; pseudoakathisia requires reassessment rather than assumption.
Motor restlessness and distress are clinician-reviewed categories; no summed severity band or treatment threshold is set here and no dose, route, frequency or active/stopped fields are set here.
Whether review outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this draft uses estimated-table semantics without approval.
Alternative-cause, exposure, onset, differential, distress, benzodiazepine safety, propranolol safety, preference and urgent operationalization require owner review.

numerical_examples: examples.json contains one complete independently worked 20-node mathematical reference: Indication 0.3/0.4/0.3, Regimen 0.042/0.06/0.09/0.09/0.018/0.7 with a Dose/Switch transpose guard (swapped gives ReviewDose 0.09 and ReviewSwitch 0.06), Adjunct 0.12/0.18/0.7, Urgent 0.2/0.8, Burden 0.105/0.4/0.495, Benzo 0.289375/0.710625 with a Respiratory/Misuse transpose guard (swapped gives 0.224375), Propranolol 0.44/0.56. Two opposing projections of the same CPT yield identical posteriors, proving no clamping. This validates math and engineering only; clinical expected_for_review cases remain unapproved.
